findings.description: The coin resting on top of the middle cup sinks down into the cup between 00:02 and 00:03 without being touched or acted upon.
The initiated action of placing coins into the cups stalls mid-motion, with the coins sliding along the exterior rims from 00:03 to 00:07 rather than completing the drop.
